earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 ex991q32026.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 News Release Lockheed Martin Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results • Sales increased 11% to $20.7 billion • Net earnings increased 14% to $1.8 billion, or $7.97 per share • Cash from operations of $3.4 billion and free cash flow of $3.0 billion • Record backlog of $292.0 billion, including $52.5 billion associated with the multi-year award to produce PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE) interceptors • Updates 2026 financial outlook BETHESDA, Md., Oct. 22, 2026 – Lockheed Martin Corporation [NYSE: LMT] today reported third quarter 2026 sales of $20.7 billion, compared to $18.6 billion in the third quarter of 2025. Net earnings in the third quarter of 2026 were $1.8 billion, or $7.97 per share, compared to $1.6 billion, or $6.95 per share. Cash from operations was $3.4 billion in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $3.7 billion in the third quarter of 2025. Free cash flow was $3.0 billion in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $3.3 billion in the third quarter of 2025. Backlog grew 27% since the second quarter of 2026, setting another new record at $292.0 billion. “Our strong third quarter performance underscores Lockheed Martin’s continuing leadership in the development and delivery of advanced and reliable defense technology solutions. Every day, our research, engineering and production teams are putting highly effective and scalable capabilities in the field. We strive to improve mission performance on a continuous basis by combining proven systems like Aegis, F-35, and Hellfire with the latest digital technologies including AI and Autonomy. We are doing this by integrating our internal innovative solutions with those of start-ups, new entrants into our industry, and commercial technology leaders.” said Lockheed Martin Chairman, President and CEO Jim Taiclet. “By pulling through our existing platforms and systems using innovations from multiple sources and with newly available digital technology, we can drive elevated growth in our financial performance as well. In the third quarter each of our four segments posted growth year-over-year, sales topped $20.7 billion and net earnings exceeded $1.8 billion, increases of 11% and 14% respectively. We delivered $3 billion of free cash flow in the quarter, and increased our backlog to a record $292 billion, allowing us to raise our dividend for the 24 th year in a row. The sustained financial momentum across our portfolio gives us confidence to increase our outlook for sales, earnings per share and free cash flow, the second consecutive quarter we have raised our financial guidance.” 1 Summary Financial Results (in millions, except per share data) Quarters Ended Nine Months Ended Sept. 27, 2026 Sept. 28, 2025 Sept. 27, 2026 Sept. 28, 2025 Sales $ 20,711 $ 18,609 $ 58,795 $ 54,727 Business segment operating profit 1 $ 2,229 $ 2,029 $ 6,214 $ 4,685 Unallocated items FAS/CAS pension operating adjustment 421 380 1,264 1,138 Impairment and other charges — — — (66) Intangible asset amortization expense (49) (70) (149) (197) Other, net (158) (59) (344) (160) Total unallocated items 214 251 771 715 Consolidated operating profit $ 2,443 $ 2,280 $ 6,985 $ 5,400 Net earnings $ 1,845 $ 1,619 $ 5,169 $ 3,673 Diluted earnings per share $ 7.97 $ 6.95 $ 22.36 $ 15.69 Cash from operations $ 3,438 $ 3,728 $ 6,893 $ 5,338 Capital expenditures (439) (381) (1,268) (1,186) Free cash flow 1 $ 2,999 $ 3,347 $ 5,625 $ 4,152 1 Business segment operating profit and free cash flow are non-GAAP measures. reference.summary: Lockheed Martin Corporation, an aerospace and defense company, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, integration, and sustainment of technology systems, products, and services in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Aeronautics; Missiles and Fire Control (MFC); Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS); and Space. The Aeronautics segment offers combat and air mobility aircraft, unmanned air vehicles, and related technologies. The MFC segment provides air and missile defense systems; tactical missiles and precision strike weapon systems; logistics; fire control systems; mission operations support, readiness, engineering support, and integration services; and ground vehicles.
